First_end: ^As the detective gets close to that stranger, he notices that that thing just had a shape of a human but he wasn't. That was the stranger monster that walks on the train at night. He was the reason why passengers that take that train, never leave. And the last thing that he remembers, is the darkness and that monster's horrible smile before getting eaten.
Second_end: ^The detective takes his gun and looks through the peephole. Then he hears steps. Through the peepholehe doesn't see a human but a horrible monster. He looks how that monster takes the shape of the 'passenger' and scream again waiting for his next victim to come out. He likes to play with their victims, play roles before haunting them, just as he was doing with the detective. The detective was just there, looking throught that whole, unable to make a move. He knew a gun was not going to kill that thing, so he just waited until the sun came out, as well as the passengers. They were all acting normal, none of them seemed like they had a bad night. Where was the dead body?, did anyone remember the man who was killed? The answer was no. That thing ate him, and with his magic made the passengers forget about last night. Now, the detective had to survive that night. Just as he did last night.
Third_end: ^The detective slowly regains consciousness. While he opens his eyes he sees the other passenger on his side. Are you okay? The passenger asks with a worried face. The detective nods in affirmation. Well, that is good to see, says the passenger as he slowly grows his extremities and his smile gets bigger on each side. The detective due to his fear is unable to move. The last thing he saw was that monster opening his mouth after saying: "Don't worry, nobody will remember that you existed".
